[[File:Waterbirth Teleport icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Waterbirth Teleport''' teleports the player beside [[Jarvald]]'s ship on [[Waterbirth Island]], right by the [[snape grass]] spawns. As with all [[Lunar spells]], the quest [[Lunar Diplomacy]] must be completed to cast this spell.

Casting this spell is a [[hard Fremennik Diary]] task.
